worked_example.problem: Lum must cook rice and stew and wash yesterday's pots before lunch. How can dovetailing save time?
steps: Start the rice first, since it takes the longest.
While the rice boils, make the stew and wash the pots.
Doing jobs at the same time is dovetailing: the meal is ready sooner.
worked_example.answer: Wash the pots and make the stew while the rice boils.

cards.idea: Managing time in the kitchen means meals on time, less tiredness, fewer accidents, and fuel and money saved.
example: A cook who rushes is more likely to get burnt.

cards.idea: Ways to save time: plan the menu, prepare ingredients first, dovetail, use labour-saving equipment, clean as you go.
example: Dovetailing: wash up while the rice boils.

cards.idea: Work in order: plan the menu, buy the food, prepare, cook, serve, then wash up.
example: Planning first means nothing is forgotten at the market.

check.prompt: What should come first when preparing a meal?

wrong.explain: Washing up comes at the end.
You must plan, buy and prepare before cooking.
Eating comes after the food is served.

questions.prompt: Which is an advantage of managing time in the kitchen?

wrong.explain: That has nothing to do with time management.
Good planning means the cook does not need to rush.
Good time management makes meals ready on time.

pick.t: doing two jobs at the same time, such as washing up while the rice boils
pick.why: Dovetailing: doing two jobs at the same time, such as washing up while the rice boils.

pick.t: deciding what to cook for the week before going to market
pick.why: Planning the menu: deciding what to cook for the week before going to market.

pick.t: washing, peeling and cutting everything before starting to cook
pick.why: Preparing the ingredients first: washing, peeling and cutting everything before starting to cook.

pick.t: washing each pot as soon as you finish with it
pick.why: Cleaning as you go: washing each pot as soon as you finish with it.

pick.t: grinding pepper with a blender instead of a grinding stone
pick.why: Using labour-saving equipment: grinding pepper with a blender instead of a grinding stone.

questions.prompt:
Which way of saving time is this?
{x.t}

misconceptions.explain: Not that one. Read what the cook does.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Dovetailing means doing two jobs at once.
Planning the menu saves time at the market.
Cleaning as you go saves time at the end.

wrong.text: Rushing in the kitchen prevents accidents.
wrong.explain: Rushing causes accidents; planning prevents them.

wrong.text: You should cook before buying the food.
wrong.explain: Plan, buy and prepare first; then cook.
